text:
jess: Quick a11y sweep on models list + side panel. A few recurring things: focus sometimes gets lost when closing the flyout, several small chips/buttons fail contrast, and NVDA reads an extra 'button' label on model rows. Posting quick notes so we can triage.

matt: Thanks — can you paste a minimal repro? I couldn't repro in local with keyboard only.

jess: Repro steps I used on staging: tab to models list, press Enter on a row to open flyout, press Esc to close. Focus lands at the top of the page instead of back on the activated row. Also tried Shift+Tab and focus jumps to an invisible wrapper.

olga: I can repro on latest staging. Also noticed toolbar filter -> models list tab order sometimes skips the Apply button (keyboard focus goes straight to the list items).

kevin: Likely two issues: (1) we aren't restoring focus to the trigger on close; (2) flyout DOM uses an offscreen element that still accepts focus. Quick fixes: restore focus on close, and move the offscreen element to aria-hidden when closed.

kevin: Proposed small CSS/JS snippet for focus restore + visible focus style (feel free to tweak):

```
/* stronger focus ring for keyboard users */
:focus {
  outline: 3px solid #0a84ff; /* high contrast blue */
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

// on flyout close (pseudo)
function closeFlyout(triggerEl, flyoutEl) {
  flyoutEl.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  flyoutEl.removeAttribute('tabindex');
  triggerEl.focus();
}
```

jess: That focus ring looks good — please check dark theme too (contrast + thickness).

aria-bot: Automated a11y check results: 3 color contrast failures detected. Examples:
- `.chip-label` (text #9B9B9B on #FFFFFF): fails AA for 12px. Suggest #6E6E6E or #505050.
- `.muted-action` (#777777 on #0F1720): borderline in dark mode, recommend #9AA1A8.
- `.focus-outline` (if using 2px on dark bg): increase to 3px for adequate visibility.

matt: Thanks — I'll own the focus restoration and ARIA attributes. Plan: add `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` to row toggles, ensure flyout has `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="false"` (since it's not blocking), and restore focus to the row on close.

matt: Quick aria attribute sketch: `button.toggle` gets `aria-expanded="true|false"` and `aria-controls="model-flyout-<id>"`. Flyout: `role="dialog" aria-labelledby="model-title-<id>"`. Also change list markup: `ul[role=list] > li[role=listitem]` and avoid nested interactive elements without clear labels.

kevin: I'll take the color pass. I'll update the tokens for `muted` and `chip` in tokens.json and run visual smoke in dark/light.

olga: After those changes I can run NVDA + VoiceOver checks and post a short test matrix. Please ping me when PR's up.

jess: Also small copy nit: model row verbage reads 'Open' and VoiceOver says 'Open button button' sometimes — probably because we have a visible label and an aria-label. Avoid duplicate labels.

matt: Good catch. I'll remove redundant aria-labels where visible text exists.

jess: Cool. Owners: Matt (focus + aria), Kevin (colors + focus halo), Olga (validation). I'll follow up with a short acceptance checklist we can paste into the PR. :thumbsup:

olga: Sounds good — will add keyboard-only checklist items (tab order, esc behavior, focus restore, announce text).

matt: PR incoming later today. If anyone sees other quick wins (tabindex misuse, invisible focusable wrappers) drop them here.

jess: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn.
